The Productivity Effects of Generative AI on Task Completion

Svanberg, M. (2024). Working paper.

Abstract: We measure the productivity effects of generative AI assistance in
a randomized rollout across knowledge-work teams. Access to generative AI
increases task completion by 14 percent on average. The estimated effect is
concentrated among less-experienced workers and attenuates as task
complexity rises. We find no evidence of quality degradation in completed
tasks.
